title: Restore the stock fork damping baseline

applicability.included: Exact standard US2024 YZ450F original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, replacement springs/components or aftermarket damping conversions

entry_state: Assembled bike, serviceable stock suspension, exact original adjusters identified.
exit_state: Recorded adjustment and functional checks complete; no internal service performed.
preflight: Stop for leaks, damage, binding or an unidentified adjuster.
Keep the linked diagrams visible to identify distinct controls.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster at stop before target, inability to identify stock control, or unresolved setup measurement

required_tools.name: Appropriate damping driver and precision torque tool for1.3Nm

source.review_note: Independent root review approved exact2024 instructions, diagrams, values and bounded scope; plain page references and stage-specific lubricant materials corrected before freeze.

steps.title: Inspect both legs
steps.instruction: Support the assembled bike upright. Inspect inner tubes for damage and fork joints for leaks. Apply front brake and compress the fork several times; it must rebound smoothly. Resolve damage/leaks/binding before adjusting.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion reconciled against exact 2024 BHR source; logging/support and closed-caliper retention are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record both sides
steps.instruction: Identify bottom rebound and top compression controls from PDF 108. Gently turn each toward full hard, counting and saving the original clicks so they can be restored. Never force a stop. Actual total travel can vary from nominal; do not manufacture missing clicks.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion reconciled against exact 2024 BHR source; logging/support and closed-caliper retention are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Release trapped air
steps.instruction: Raise front wheel securely. Remove each leg bleed screw shown PDF 109 to release internal pressure, then refit each at 1.3 N·m. Keep dirt out and return both screws before setting damping.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion reconciled against exact 2024 BHR source; logging/support and closed-caliper retention are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set rebound
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each lower rebound adjuster 11 clicks outward in diagram direction b. Both legs must match. Source nominal range is 0–20 clicks; stop if actual mechanism cannot reach the standard without force.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion reconciled against exact 2024 BHR source; logging/support and closed-caliper retention are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set compression
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each top compression adjuster 10 clicks outward in diagram direction b. Both legs must match. Source nominal range is 0–20 clicks; never force beyond actual travel.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion reconciled against exact 2024 BHR source; logging/support and closed-caliper retention are explicit workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Verify the baseline
steps.instruction: Lower the bike from its stand. Recheck smooth fork action, both secured bleed screws and matched settings. Record rebound 11/compression 10 clicks out per leg and any unresolved symptoms. This restores damping only; fork height, oil and springs were not changed.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Original illustrated companion reconciled against exact 2024 BHR source; logging/support and closed-caliper retention are explicit workflow adaptations.

completeness: Restore both original fork damping settings, release trapped air and record functional checks. Oil, springs and fork height remain unchanged.
